title: Coding-suite run event
description: One structured JSON Lines event emitted by a coding-suite agent (dev-lead, architect, coding, infrastructure, or any reviewer) at a phase boundary, on a non-trivial tool call, on a quality-gate decision, or on completion. Append-only — see SKILL.md. Sentinel blocks remain canonical hand-off; this event log is additive telemetry.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC with millisecond precision and Z suffix, e.g. '2026-04-15T08:42:17.123Z'.

run_id.description: UUID (UUIDv7 recommended) minted by dev-lead at run start. Same value for every event in a run.

agent.description: Which coding-suite agent emitted the event.

event_type.description: Discriminator. See references/event-types.md for required-field rules per event_type.

correlation_id.description: Optional grouping key — typically the parent task or work-item id. Lets analysis tooling group events that belong to the same logical user request across multiple runs.

parent_event_id.description: Optional id of the event that caused this one (e.g. the phase_start that this phase_complete closes).

outcome.description: Required for phase_complete, run_complete, gate_check. Forbidden for phase_start / run_start.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock duration in milliseconds for the action this event describes.

tool_name.description: Required for event_type=tool_call. Name of the tool invoked, e.g. 'view', 'edit', 'powershell', 'github-create_pull_request'.

args_summary.description: Redacted ≤200-char summary of tool arguments. NEVER include secrets, full file contents, or PII. For restricted projects, hash file paths (SHA-256 first 12 hex chars) before including them.

error_kind.description: Required for event_type=error. Short machine-readable category, e.g. 'tool_timeout', 'validation_failed', 'gate_blocked', 'rate_limited'.

payload.description: Free-form structured detail. Same redaction rules apply (no secrets, no full file contents, no unredacted PII).

payload.user_request_summary: Add Bicep module for Storage Account with private endpoint
